introHtml: PL paper bags offer a durable, eco-friendly packaging solution for businesses looking to reduce plastic use. These custom paper bags come in a range of sizes, from small 6x8 inch treat bags to large 16x12 inch shopper totes, and can be printed with your logo or design using flexographic or digital printing. Perfect for retail stores, trade shows, or corporate gifting, PL paper bags provide a natural, recyclable canvas that aligns with sustainable brand values.
